mentions.name: Agentic bubble sort experiment
mentions.description: An experimental implementation of the agentic bubble sort concept from Michael Levin's Ingressing Minds paper preprint, built as a playful exploration of the paper's ideas about agency.
mentions.source_excerpt: Right now I'm playing around with some of the concepts mentioned by Michael Levin in his Ingressing Minds paper preprint. I'm implementing their agentic bubble sort for fun.
mentions.author: drakonka
